node.title: Maximum prefix fiber equals one plus maximum local shift-pair degree
node.statement: For any support-wise first-match residual family partitioned by the depth-t elementary locator-prefix map, form the graph whose vertices are residual A-subsets and whose edges join distinct supports with equal prefix. Each nonempty prefix fiber is a clique and there are no edges between fibers, so max_z |R_z|=1+max_S deg(S) exactly. Distinct same-prefix supports have Johnson side-distance e>=t+1; after removing their common core, the two disjoint e-locators form a shift pair, and at e=t+1 their difference is a nonzero constant. Therefore the official N^3 maximum-prefix target is equivalent to a uniform local primitive shift-pair degree at most N^3-1 after the same paid strips. A global second-moment identity controls only the average degree and does not replace this local bound.
